_comment: WHAT THE PANEL SHOWS (note section 13), case by case. Driven by tests/fa_colloquial_panel.mjs, which runs these cases in the book reader and in the video player against the real routes, reading the page as drawn, not the answer's JSON. `row` names a row of rows/ by family and word (`at`: which of them, from 0, where there are several); `shows` is the CONTENT the card must hold, in words, which the test maps to the panel's own markup (lib/parseh.js `Parseh.spoken`). Every case holds in both surfaces.

shows.note: a word the dictionary knows is drawn exactly as today: no pill, no reading, no tint

shows.senses: those of the formal entry خانه
shows.look: tinted, with a dotted edge, and a pill, so that a guess cannot be taken for an entry

shows.note: the pieces in the order they were read, each in words
the same lemma read two ways is one card with a second line
داشتن is not offered as 'to have'
the formal word's sound, labelled; never a spoken one invented
the page's hint does not push a plainly formal word behind its spoken reading
laughter is not looked up; the panel says what it says today for a word it does not find
